items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I play a free piece with Clark Terry and a free trio with Gerry Mulligan and Peggy Stern

ctx.x: That’s interesting, too. I play a free piece with Clark Terry and a free trio with Gerry Mulligan and Peggy Stern; no ego there. Gerry is just “Okay, let’s do that”, no questions asked.
